summary: Iteration 7 — Auth UI overhaul + role-aware redirects + register plan selector + backend/DB spec doc. Backend smoke (GET /api/, POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me) passes. 11/11 frontend UI scenarios PASS: login page renders with all data-testids (heading 'Entrar na sua conta', email/password/submit/google/demo-user/demo-admin), manual creator login -> /app/dashboard, demo-admin-login-btn -> /admin with UP ADMIN branding + Painel Geral, demo-user-login-btn -> /app/dashboard, manual admin form login -> /admin (role-aware), header-admin-link with href='/admin' visible for admin on /app, invalid login shows login-error, register page has 3 plan buttons (start/pro/agencia) with visual selection change, new user registration (teste+<ts>@upideias.com/Teste@2026) succeeds and lands on /app/dashboard, landing regression OK. BACKEND_DATABASE.md exists at 149 lines.

minor.issue: On invalid email format (e.g. '*@example.invalid'), backend returns raw 422 Pydantic validation JSON. Frontend surfaces the raw JSON string inside login-error instead of a friendly pt-BR message. Consider catching validation errors and returning {detail: 'E-mail inválido'}.

ui_bugs.issue: login-error displays raw FastAPI 422 JSON when email format is invalid (starts with '[{"type":"value_error"...'). Should parse detail[0].msg or map to friendly Portuguese text.

issues: Pro plan does NOT expose a distinguishable initial 'selected' state via aria-pressed or a class difference vs Start on first render (initial class of Pro matched Start after Start was clicked, meaning Pro was likely selected initially but no accessible attribute like aria-pressed/aria-selected is set — add aria-pressed for a11y). Visual selection change on click works.

action_items: Parse /api/auth/login 422 responses in the frontend and show a friendly pt-BR message (e.g. 'E-mail ou senha inválidos') instead of raw JSON.
Add aria-pressed / aria-selected on register-plan-* buttons to improve a11y and enable state-based testing (currently only visual class differences).
Preload warnings for woff2 fonts appear on every auth page — either drop the <link rel=preload> or ensure font-family actually references them within the initial paint window.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard page throws 'Failed to fetch' after logout because loadDashboardData still runs post-redirect (useEffect not aborted). Add an AbortController or guard by session state to avoid noisy console errors and possible race conditions.

AuthShell brand panel text 'UP IDEIAS' renders as styled markup — inner_text still shows 'UP' + 'IDEIAS' but the app sidebar's brand may be an SVG/logo without accessible text. Confirm sr-only label like UP Ideias is present for screen readers.
Login error surface passes through backend detail without shape checking — hostile inputs could inject long JSON strings into the UI. Sanitize / cap length.

Do not exhaustively test wrong-password path (5 attempts / 15 min lockout per ip:email). Use fresh browser contexts between admin/user because httpOnly cookies persist.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional failures. The single UX issue (raw 422 JSON in login-error) is caused by the frontend blindly rendering backend 'detail' as string. When Pydantic returns a validation error, detail is a list of dicts serialized to JSON in the error message. Fix: in login onSubmit catch, if err.detail is an array, show a generic friendly message ('Verifique seu e-mail e senha').
